meta.methodology: Static flat-EF context, not a live hourly series -- Hydro-Quebec's hourly export is a manually-placed file (see HeatPump/pipeline/fetch_hq.py), and Quebec's grid is >99% hydro/wind, so a live refresh pipeline isn't warranted. avg_ef_g_per_kwh is a simple (unweighted) mean of AvgEF_g_per_kWh across all available hours; see HeatPump/METHODOLOGY.md for the full combustion-only model and the flagged open question around import-based marginal intensity.
